sloka: तम् श्रुत्वा निनदम् भ्रातुः क्रुद्धो वाली महाबलः ।निष्पपात सुसंरब्धो भास्करो अस्त तटात् इव ॥४-१२-१६॥
transliteration: tam śrutvā ninadam bhrātuḥ kruddho vālī mahābalaḥ ।niṣpapāta susaṁrabdho bhāskaro asta taṭāt iva ॥4-12-16॥

translations.english: On hearing his brother roaring, powerful Vali was enraged and rushed like the Sun from behind the western shore of the ocean (this simile suggests the downfall of Vali).
